hooks.name: conn-session-start
hooks.description: Summarize the focused Conn Intent, or recommend /conn-start in a connected repository. Reads only; never blocks.

hooks.name: conn-prompt-submit
hooks.description: Report new Conn collisions, decisions, and counterpart revisions since the last prompt, and deliver queued write warnings. Reads only; never blocks.

hooks.name: conn-pre-write
hooks.description: Warn before a write that touches another Intent's claims or an open collision. The warning never blocks the write.

hooks.name: conn-post-write
hooks.description: Record the repository-relative path an agent wrote, never its content. Reads nothing from the backend.
